summary: Phase 149O.20L.7D.2 -- Dell Class-B Real Host Provisioning Execution Retry. Retried the CHGR-authorized (chgr-96a0ce12756e4cc892492a87af1db832) nine-action Boundary-P plan from a freshly reverified entry state: independently re-verified CHGR entry (published/approve/unrevoked/unsuperseded), reconstructed the immutable nine-action plan from pinned commit f9e33232c83163aad5e50bc94db7cab51b844ac5, confirmed zero drift in src/pcae/**, scripts/**, and docs/contracts/** since pin 7a3fa971304521cdcb44251e07ef1966baec686a, reconfirmed Dell identity (machine-id 54ff22ce400b475aa0d55cb68f4a3334 exact match), reverified the 149O.20L.7D.1 credential prerequisite unchanged (GitHub deploy key id 160313031, read_only: true), reconfirmed Class-B infrastructure fully absent, and passed the rollback-readiness gate for all nine actions. Actions 1-5 executed and read-back verified exactly per the frozen plan: package prerequisites installed; pcae group/user created (uid/gid 1004, nologin, no sudo, single group); Protected Root /etc/pcae/hatp/trust-store created root:pcae 750; full eight-path runtime/state tree created root:pcae 750; /home/pcae normalized pcae:pcae 750. Action 6 (clone at the pinned commit into /opt/pcae/runtime/src) succeeded at the clone/checkout/detached-HEAD/exact-SHA level -- unblocking the exact step that stopped Phase 149O.20L.7D before the 149O.20L.7D.1 credential was provisioned -- but failed its own clean-working-tree read-back requirement: the frozen forward command's blanket 'find -type f -exec chmod 0640' strips the executable bit from a handful of files the repository tracks as 100755 (.githooks/pre-commit, .githooks/pre-push, scripts/check-docs-updated.sh, plus 3 JSON artifacts), producing a non-empty git status --short (6 files, 0 content changes -- mode-only, confirmed via git diff --stat). This is a genuine defect in the frozen Action-6 command text, discovered only by real execution, not a production code defect. Per governing instruction, no substitute command was invented and no redesign was attempted; Action 6 was cleanly rolled back to Action 4's own empty-directory postcondition using its own frozen rollback commands, independently verified (0 entries, root:pcae 750). Forward execution then stopped -- Actions 7 (venv/editable-install), 8 (wrapper), and 9 (local Class-B verifier) were not attempted. Actions 1-5 remain successfully provisioned and were independently reconfirmed idempotent (EXACTLY SATISFIED on re-check) at phase close, providing a retry-safe baseline for a future execution attempt. The 149O.20L.7D.1 credential prerequisite was independently reverified unchanged and was not touched by this phase's rollback, per governing instruction's explicit carve-out. No DeploymentBinding was created. Boundary C and Boundary A remain NOT AUTHORIZED. Class-B remains NOT PROVISIONED (the nine-action graph did not complete). Runtime unchanged (Observed/observe/unavailable). CHGR chgr-96a0ce12756e4cc892492a87af1db832 re-inspected at phase close: digest unchanged, not marked consumed, remains available for a future retry once the Action-6 defect is repaired. No production source repair was attempted -- the finding is disclosed as a proposition-command defect requiring a dedicated amendment phase. New, independently authored companion test module -- 16 tests, re-run three consecutive times, 16 passed each run, no flake -- covering CHGR entry, source freshness, Dell identity, credential-prerequisite non-mutation, Actions 1-5 success, Action 6 failure/rollback, Actions 7-9 non-attempt, DeploymentBinding/Boundary-C/A absence, CHGR integrity, no-production-repair, and secret-leakage grep across tracked files. Recommends exactly one next phase: 149O.20L.7D.3 -- a narrow proposition amendment to repair the Action-6 file-mode command defect, requiring a fresh AMEND/APPROVE election before any further provisioning retry. Does not recommend 149O.20L.7E, since provisioning did not complete. No certification. No activation. Stops here.
